女包公/女张飞: female Judge Bao / female Zhang Fei
移花接木: transplant the blossom to another branch, metaphor for finding A’qiao another partner
同科: graduate in the same class, humorous metaphor about sharing a former lover
本家: proprietress of a courtesan house, not a relative
第六章暂缓安排: Mrs Hu is asked to feign ignorance temporarily; Seventh Lady promises resolution within three months without violating her rule
